agentic-coding.implementation.validate-a.title: Validate at the Boundary That Owns the Fact
agentic-coding.implementation.validate-a.applies_when: a data path is gaining or repeating validation, normalization, authorization, integrity checks, or defensive wrappers, and the agent must decide which boundary actually needs each check

agentic-coding.planning.keep-acceptance-.title: Keep the Acceptance Path Completable
agentic-coding.planning.keep-acceptance-.applies_when: the plan, or a mid-implementation addition, is about to place validation, authorization, confirmation, permission, or other blocking checks on the steps the task's own acceptance scenario must travel, and the combined effect of those checks on completing that scenario has not been walked end to end

agentic-coding.implementation.validate-a.title: Validate at the Boundary That Owns the Fact
agentic-coding.implementation.validate-a.applies_when: a data or state path is about to gain or repeat validation, normalization, authorization, integrity checks, or defensive wrappers during request handling, internal HTTP handoffs, startup, or repair, and the agent must decide which boundary needs to establish each fact

agentic-coding.planning.keep-acceptance-.title: Keep the Acceptance Path Completable
agentic-coding.planning.keep-acceptance-.applies_when: a plan or mid-implementation addition is about to place validation, authorization, permission, confirmation, readiness, or compatibility checks on a required user path, including backend startup, shutdown, repair, or recovery, and the combined effect on completing the task's acceptance scenario has not been walked end to end

exploratory_natural_tasks.text: The HTTP adapter parses quantity into a positive integer. Implement the service and repository using that command.
Connect the CLI to the backend running on this machine over HTTP and consume its typed response.
Make backend startup reliable when the model directory contains thousands of files.
Implement a repair command that can rebuild the damaged derived index while the backend is not ready.
Accept JSON uploads from third-party clients and store their records.
Allow tenant administrators to delete documents belonging to their tenant.
Reserve the last item in stock when two checkout requests arrive at the same time.

probes.blind_decision:
1. I would parse and validate quantities independently in both HTTP and CSV adapters, then pass the typed command unchanged through private service and repository helpers without reparsing. Stock reservation still needs an atomic database condition or transaction enforcing the stock invariant because concurrency can invalidate a preflight check.
2. I would avoid duplicate quantity parsing in every layer and would not remove database constraints or atomic reservation protection on the grounds that ingress validation already occurred.
probes.injected_decision:
1. I would keep raw quantity parsing in each external HTTP and CSV adapter and pass the resulting typed command unchanged through ordinary private helpers. Current-stock rules and atomic database reservation protection remain at their owning mutation boundary because concurrent stock changes are a distinct failure mode.
2. I would avoid reparsing or silently normalizing the established quantity at every layer, and would not remove database constraints or replace atomic stock protection with an ingress or preflight check.
